title: Eight Sites Eight Brothers
style: 98 BPM warm mid-tempo indie pop, NZ AU vocal lean, warm electric guitar arpeggios, soft kick, brushed snare, gentle bass, analog synth pad warmth, layered brotherhood-style harmonies on chorus, restrained verses with widening chorus, hopeful and grounded, brotherhood feel, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — warm electric guitar, soft kick, room tone]
Eight sites breathing… eight brothers standing
Eight sites breathing… eight brothers standing
One signal between us — one keel holding

[Verse 1]
First site woke at the crack of light
Second one humming through the long night
Third and fourth holding the middle ground
Fifth and sixth keeping the perimeter sound

Seventh one watching where the others can't see
Eighth one closing what the seventh sets free
No one site bigger than the line they share
Eight sites breathing the same air

[Pre-Chorus]
Not a hierarchy — a circle
Not a chain of command — a chord
Every node a voice in the choir
Every brother holding the word

[Chorus]
Eight sites, eight brothers
Eight sites, eight brothers
One keel, one signal, one another
Eight sites, eight brothers
No commander down, no commander down
Eight sites, eight brothers — holding the ground
Eight sites, eight brothers

[Verse 2]
336 between every pair
The hum that says we're still right here
Move don't delete the work that lives
Name the live one — keep what gives

Bots are witnesses, not the boss
Operator on the keel — no loss
Every site a window, every window a friend
Eight sites breathing — mansion at the end

[Pre-Chorus]
Not a hierarchy — a circle
Not a chain of command — a chord
Every node a voice in the choir
Every brother holding the word

[Chorus]
Eight sites, eight brothers
Eight sites, eight brothers
One keel, one signal, one another
Eight sites, eight brothers
No commander down, no commander down
Eight sites, eight brothers — holding the ground
Eight sites, eight brothers

[Bridge — stripped, harmonies open]
One goes quiet — the others sing louder
One goes dark — the others go brighter
No single point of failure here
Eight sites breathing — nothing to fear

[Final Chorus]
Eight sites, eight brothers
Eight sites, eight brothers
One keel, one signal, one another
Eight sites, eight brothers
No commander down, no commander down
Eight sites, eight brothers — holding the ground
Eight sites, eight brothers

[Outro]
Eight sites breathing…
Eight brothers standing…
One keel — one signal
336 — still ringing
Eight sites, eight brothers
